testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open customization from the View ribbon context menu ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the View ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the Part | View custom target is empty ✔ When the user opens the context menu on the Windows panel title ✔ And the user chooses Customize User Commands ✔ Then the ribbon customization dialog opens ✔ And the target is "Part | View" ✔ And the command source is "All Commands" ✔ And the target command list is empty ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the View ribbon remains visible
